title: My Half-Sister Forged Dissolution, Sold $610K Typewriters, Mailed $4,500. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 28 years I cashed out my 401(k) to open a vintage typewriter shop with my half-sister, then she forged a dissolution and sold the inventory for $610,000, mailing me a $4,500 platen check. I found our original partnership agreement hidden inside a 1920s Royal typewriter and voided the sale. Now she polishes key levers in a smock that says Shifted My Pension. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #ProRevenge
thumb_text: SHE FORGED. I FOUND THE AGREEMENT. SALE VOIDED.
pinned_comment: If my half-sister forged a dissolution, sold my $610,000 vintage typewriter inventory, and mailed me a $4,500 platen check, would you have voided the sale or confronted her first? Share your story in the comments.
